ideas.title: Following the Money in Childcare Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the financial trails of childcare fraud cases to identify potential patterns and connections.
questions: What are the most common methods used to commit childcare fraud?
How much money is being drained from aid programs?
ideas.insight: I believe that following the money in childcare fraud cases could reveal significant patterns and connections. By analyzing financial data, we may be able to identify common methods used to commit fraud and track the flow of money.
